# Food Buff: Prickeye Salad

**Buff**

| **Base Buff** | **Herbivore Mutation** | **Mutation and SIN Perk Card** | **Duration** |
| +10 Damage Resistance | +20 Damage Resistance | +25 Damage Resistance | 60 minutes |

**Glowing Gut Perk Card**

Note: Herbivore mutation removes radiation from vegetable-based foods, so Prickeye Salad will NOT give rads if the player has the Herbivore mutation.

| **Perk Rank** | **Total Rads** |
| None | 10 Rads |
| Rank 1 | 20 Rads |
| Rank 2 | 30 Rads |
| Rank 3 | 40 Rads |

**Spoil Rate**

| **Food Type** | **Base** | **30% Reduced** | **50% Reduced** | **60% Reduced** | **90% Reduced** |
| Raw Vegetable Large | 1h 30m | 1h 57m | 2h 15m | 2h 24m | 2h 51m |

**Weight**

0.10 pounds

**How to obtain**

**Recipe**

Learned the first time you pick up a Prickeye.

**Cooked Dish**

None

**Recipe**

2x Tato

1x Salt

4x Prickeye

**Workbench**

Cooking Station > Plants

Cooking Station > All Food

**Stacking**

This is a food buff, so it will not stack with other Damage Resistance food buffs.

It will stack with chems, alcohol, bobbleheads, magazines, and all other non-food categories.

**Technical**

**Form ID**

008468C6

**Hunger Bar Restore**

720 points

**Thirst Bar Restore**

0 points

**Radiation**

10 Rads

**Value**

18 caps

**Persists on World Change**

Not specified

**Persists on death**

Not specified

**Keywords**

Object Type Food

Ingredient Type Vegetable

Object Type Can Spoil

Plant Type Slipper Cactus
